_readme: Products shown on the site. Public repos in the GitHub org tagged with `topic` are picked up automatically (description, homepage, latest release). Entries below add or override fields for a repo of the same name, and can add products that are not public repos yet. Order here wins; auto-found repos not listed come after, newest first. An entry with tagline_from takes its text from that live site (meta description, og:description, or the lead paragraph); text/lang are the fallback if the site can't be reached.

products.name: gitpro
products.text: The right git name, email and SSH key in every repository, for you and the AI agents that commit for you.

products.name: releasepro
products.text: One release run for any repo: a person approves each channel, no channel publishes with a stored token, and the announcement goes last. It runs in GitHub Actions or from your own terminal.
